candidates.name: trial01
candidates.note: R only. After sustained low progress, try a clear adjacent pushing face with a translated rear-station check, using the incumbent release protocol.

candidates.name: trial02
candidates.note: R only. Reject goal-distance regression in the planned detour, shorten handback on oversized drift, and reserve the near-goal region for incumbent control.

candidates.name: trial03
candidates.note: R only. Use tighter detour selection and quicker handback near the goal, with the original alternate-face maneuver in the open-distance regime.

candidates.name: trial04
candidates.note: R only. Also try bounded route recovery if both object progress and one robot's motion remain poor after the original geometry-triggered opportunity.

candidates.name: trial05
candidates.note: P and R. Keep trial03 recovery and reduce the normal score of paired PUSH after 110 stalled ticks while waiting for contact readiness.

candidates.name: trial06
candidates.note: R only, checkpoint strategy. On a sustained stall during contact, try an immediately accessible side face if the original front is open but rear station geometry is blocked. A forced probe waives only the 100-tick progress gate.

candidates.name: trial07
candidates.note: R only. Permit three observations across the full 120-tick window and add quarter-span staging alternatives on feasible side faces, leaving the rear availability test at three samples. Native compilation rejected unequal tuple arities in this submission.

candidates.name: trial08
candidates.note: R only. Correct trial07's station list representation for native compilation, with identical intended recovery behavior.

candidates.name: trial09
candidates.note: P/R handoff. Rebuild the normal object route after a completed alternate push with at least 0.12 m of estimated progress toward the goal, so route memory is refreshed at the new pose.

candidates.name: trial10
candidates.note: R only. Keep trial03 normal recovery and offer its first legal alternate command at a forced PUSH checkpoint when geometry permits. The probe waives the persistence gate and measures a single replacement, with control returned at the next ordinary decision. The sandbox rejected its heapq import at validation.

candidates.name: trial11
candidates.note: R only. Restore the same forced-checkpoint probe with an import-free ordered queue that preserves search priority.
